name: Martsirt

format.corners: (w+1)*(h+1) row-major, corner (x,y) index y*(w+1)+x, metres, sample bilinearly in tile

road.switchback_rule: if needs_switchback: replace the straight run with N legs of <=16 m at <=14 deg joined by 4x4 flat landings (Skyrim hairpins), cliffs between legs

rules: terrain never blocks a road: terraces/cliffs only >= 3 tiles from road tiles; shoulder copies road height

phone_cost.pathing: height per corner, no navmesh change; nav stays tile-based, cliffs -> solid edges list
phone_cost.camera_occlusion: cliff steps >3 m within 8 m south of the camera path fade (dither) - flag 0 cliff tiles
phone_cost.fog_height: fog stays distance-based; optional height fog band at base-2 m for basins/gorges
